text.div: Documentation attestation questionnaire generated from Medicare LCD L33822: 5 documentation requirements.

item.text: The beneficiary's medical records will reflect the need for the care provided.
This documentation must be available upon request.
Suppliers must meet the requirement for Medical Record Information (including continued need/use if applicable).
Suppliers must meet the requirement for Correct Coding.
Suppliers must meet the requirement for Proof of Delivery.
